Overview

What is automotive window tinting?

Cars & fleets

Installed on-site across Qatar

Elevate your drive with automotive window tinting from Exotic Tint Qatar. Our premium films enhance privacy, reduce heat and protect your interior from Qatar’s harsh sun — whether you’re navigating Doha’s busy streets or parked under the blazing desert sky.

A thin, high-performance film applied to your vehicle’s glass that blocks UV rays, cuts glare and regulates interior temperature while adding a sleek finish. Unlike basic shades, our films use advanced materials engineered for Qatar’s intense sunlight and dust.

FAQ

Automotive Window Tinting FAQ

Still have a question?

Our specialists reply fast on WhatsApp, 7 days a week.

WhatsApp us Call us
Do you offer mobile car tinting?

Yes. We offer car window tinting as a home service — our team comes to your home or office anywhere in Doha, Lusail, Al Rayyan and surrounding areas.

Which tint shade should I choose?

It depends on your priorities — privacy, heat reduction or looks. During consultation we recommend a shade and film type that suits your car and complies with local regulations.

How long does installation take?

Most vehicles are completed within a few hours, including preparation, application, finishing and a final quality inspection.
